BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Scrader!!
You have no chance to throw a holy gem...
Throw the holy gem! Now!!
...Hm? There's no need to thank us.\nRight?
Yea. As the Technista, we came to secretly check\nif the Resistle are using dangerous magic like\nthe three wizards did.
Then, we saw you were having a hard fight...
We owe a lot to the Straye.\nThat's why we backed you up.\nCall it returning the favor...
What? Wastes? Yes, we looked into them...\nBlack crystals? No, we didn't see any.
What's that black crystal thing? A worker found\nthem among the wastes? We checked them in the\nincinerator, but there were no such things...
The wastes themselves were harmless, you know?\nDidn't the worker see something different?
Enough talk!\nLet's get outta here before the Resistle come...
Oh, yes. If you find something about the black\ncrystals, tell us about them next time we meet.\nSee ya.
Alright, let's go back and report to the King,\nshall we?
